verdict.rationale: ClickUp has a documented public REST API with authentication (personal tokens and OAuth2), interactive try-it docs, endpoints for tasks, comments, views, attachments, and a published OpenAPI spec reference, all clearly aimed at programmatic/automated use. This is well beyond typical vendor claims, though the probe found direct openapi.json paths 404ing, indicating the raw spec isn't trivially fetchable despite doc references. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/reliability in production use.
